profile.name: Pfeiffer TPG36x 真空规控制器
profile.description: 用于连接和管理一到两个真空规通道的真空规控制器，可读取压力并配置仪器的单位、语言及以太网参数，常用于真空系统中的压力监测与真空状态读出。
profile.description_en: A vacuum gauge controller for connecting and managing one or two vacuum gauge channels. It reads pressure and allows configuration of instrument units, language, and Ethernet settings, and is commonly used for pressure monitoring and vacuum-state readout in vacuum systems.
